q1_issues.issue: The fused compound `mire_essence` carries no genus atom; Compound concepts requires `(Inheritance mire_essence essence)` (noun modifier `mire` correctly left unexposed).

The response event is keyed to the participants, `(sk_drain $w $l)`, rather than to the triggering occurrence `$e1` that also scopes over it, and no `(During (sk_drain …) $e1)` ties it to that occurrence, so repeated approaches by one wraith to one lantern collapse into a single, temporally untethered drain.

notes: Roles (Theme for approach, Theme/Source for drain), `lit` kept as a participial adjective rather than the verb lemma, coreference of "the wraith"/"the lantern" into the rule variables, and the unmarked generic status are all correct. "When"-headed generic conditionals are routed only implicitly — the instruction set names "every time / whenever" and "if" while listing "when" among the temporal connectives — which is what leaves the During tie optional-looking.
